# Zephyr

> Zephyr is a free, local-first productivity web app for tasks, notes, a simple calendar, and a Pomodoro focus timer. It runs entirely in the browser with no login or signup — all data is stored locally on the user's device and is never sent to a server.

Zephyr is an installable Progressive Web App (PWA) that works offline. It is designed for fast, distraction-free personal productivity. There is no account system and no cloud storage; privacy is a core design goal. Made by Dominik Könitzer.

## Features

- [Tasks](https://zephyr.app/tasks): Create tasks with due dates, priorities, #tags, and folders. Supports natural-language quick add, e.g. "Email Sam tomorrow !high #work" automatically sets the due date, priority, and tag.
- [Focus Timer](https://zephyr.app/focus): A Pomodoro timer with customizable work and break durations, presets, and automatic session tracking.
- [Calendar](https://zephyr.app/calendar): A simple month calendar for basic events — title, date, optional time, and an optional note.
- [Notes](https://zephyr.app/notes): Capture and organize notes with tags and instant search.
- [Home](https://zephyr.app/): A weekly overview of focus minutes, completed tasks, and notes.

## Key facts

- Free to use, no signup or login required.
- Local-first: all data is stored in the browser via localStorage; nothing is uploaded to any server.
- Works offline as an installable PWA.
- Topics: productivity, time management, pomodoro technique, task manager, note taking, calendar.
